# SQLite amalgamation

This directory vendors SQLite 3.53.4's official amalgamation from `sqlite-amalgamation-3530400.zip` (2026-07-24). The package compiles it with `SQLITE_ENABLE_FTS5` and `SQLITE_THREADSAFE=2`.

SQLite is in the public domain. The source archive's SHA3-256 is `628a44cfe82c66aed1ccbbe85a562d2e33ebe64b3288981ed76285612227934e`.
